newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Albertson's July same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Albertson's July same-store sales rise.

text.p: NOTE: Figures in millions except percentage.
Month is five weeks ended July 31.
Full company name is Albertson's Inc.
Albertson's said that during the second quarter of 1996, its Denver division benefited from a strike that affected two of the company's competitors.
Excluding the Denver division, total sales increased 6.8 percent for the five weeks period and 7.9 percent for the 13 weeks period.
Same-stores sales increases were 0.2 percent for the fice week period and 1.11 percent for the 13-week period.
The company said it will release final sales and earnings results for the quarter on August 25.
